<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Restore a recently deleted workspace"}

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/workspaces/{workspaceKey}/restoration"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

Restores a soft-deleted workspace, together with everything that was soft-deleted as part of the same deletion event.

  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

        type: "string",
        format: "WorkspaceKey",
        "x-semantic-type": "WorkspaceKey",
        example: "0108f0ef-5c76-4a75-a602-45a9f04554fd",
        title: "WorkspaceKey",

></ParamsDetails>
